name: process-inspector-frontend

scripts.build: npm run check:watermark && npm run check:enterprise && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.gen:api: BFF=${INSPECTOR_BFF_URL:-http://localhost:8085}; curl -sf "$BFF/v3/api-docs" | grep -q SiblingDiffResponse || { echo "ERROR: BFF at $BFF is stale or down (SiblingDiffResponse missing from contract) — aborting to avoid clobbering schema.d.ts" >&2; exit 1; }; openapi-typescript "$BFF/v3/api-docs" -o src/api/schema.d.ts

//overrides: Transitive advisories pulled forward in-range — never a major across a range boundary.
brace-expansion GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr (+ siblings) patched 2.1.7+; minimatch@5 wants ^2
brace-expansion GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr (+ siblings) patched 5.0.12+; minimatch@10 wants ^5
undici          GHSA-rfgv-xxqx-mfg5 / GHSA-w293-vg96-wgc3 patched 7.29.1+; jsdom wants ^7.25
Nested @redocly override keeps its brace-expansion on the 2.x line; the top-level
^5.0.12 only applies everywhere else. DROP each once the parent resolves the patch alone
— recheck with `npm ls js-yaml brace-expansion undici`.
